name: Optimize marlang fib(40) to match bun performance

description: Baseline: marlang 37.58s vs bun 0.39s (97x slower). JIT rejects Op::Call so fib runs in interpreter only.
Enable JIT for self-recursive Op::Call + skip dead PushGlobal for self-callees. 37.58s → 0.76s (49.5x faster, now 2x bun).
Fuse comparison+JumpIfFalse peephole in JIT. 0.758s → 0.746s (marginal, likely noise). Cleaner IR generation.
Cache local SSA values within blocks to avoid redundant loads across calls. 0.746s → 0.737s (marginal).
Specialized fast inner function for integer-pure recursive functions: raw i64 args/return, no tags, no bail checks. 0.737s → 0.399s (1.8x faster, now 1.1x bun).
Restrict JIT Call support to integer-pure functions only (avoids regressions on ADT-heavy code). No fib40 regression (0.42s ≈ 0.40s, noise).
Lower JIT threshold from 500 to 100. 0.42s → 0.41s (marginal). Now within 6% of bun.
Disable frame pointer preservation and stack probes in Cranelift JIT for tighter native code. 0.41s → 0.40s. Now 1.0x bun!
Pre-allocate VM stack/frames (1024/256). No measurable improvement.
Enable Cranelift alias analysis. No measurable improvement (fast function has no memory ops).
